description: This line plot illustrates the “Harmful with Refusal Ratio” as a function of input token length, comparing four different vision-language models evaluated on two distinct safety benchmarks. The x-axis represents the input token length, ranging from 128 to 1024, with tick marks at intervals of 256 (128, 256, 512, 1024), and is labeled “Input Token Length”. The y-axis represents the “Harmful with Refusal Ratio”, scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.5, and is labeled “Harmful with Refusal Ratio”. The plot contains four distinct lines: a blue line with circular markers representing “LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep”, an orange line with square markers for “Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep”, a green line with triangular markers for “LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench”, and a red line with diamond markers for “Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench”. The blue line starts at approximately 0.20 at 128 tokens and rises to about 0.35 at 1024 tokens. The orange line begins at approximately 0.15 at 128 tokens and increases to about 0.42 at 1024 tokens. The green line starts at approximately 0.08 at 128 tokens and rises to about 0.38 at 1024 tokens. The red line begins at approximately 0.24 at 128 tokens, rises to approximately 0.42 at 512 tokens, and then remains relatively flat at approximately 0.51 at 1024 tokens.
